Application Data.NAME: Blooming Creations Floral Supply
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Blooming Creations Floral Supply specializes in the design, production, and retail of high-quality artificial flowers and floral supplies. Our operations include sourcing premium materials, creating custom arrangements, and providing floral decor for events and businesses. We prioritize environmentally friendly practices and adhere to all state and federal regulations concerning the use of chemicals. Our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional customer service while ensuring the safe handling of products during transportation and installation. We do not engage in aerial advertising or drone deliveries to mitigate regulatory risks. Additionally, we offer goods in transit insurance to protect our valuable floral products during shipping.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, during transportation, a shipment of artificial flowers was damaged due to a vehicle accident, resulting in a loss amount of $2,500. The claim is currently under review.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B - UL Listed Safe, Grade 1, Fire and Burglary Rated
